jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535469&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelors Degree in Accounting from a recognized university. Candidates having additional training/qualifications in Accounting or Finance will receive preference. Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Educational Technology (Edtech) Startup Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years Minimum 1 year of relevant working experience in Accounts/Finance. Previous experience working in STEP, SEIP, SICIP or similar skills-development/donor-funded projects will be given preference. Practical experience in maintaining cash books, ledgers, bank reconciliation, VAT, tax, journal, bills and vouchers will be highly valued. Excellent working knowledge of MS Word and MS Excel is essential. Good understanding of accounting principles and financial documentation. Practical knowledge of Bangladesh tax and VAT procedures. Strong numerical and analytical skills. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality of financial information. Ability to work independently and meet deadlines. Honest, sincere, disciplined and responsible. Ability to work effectively in a project-based environment. Required Technical Skills : The candidate must have practical knowledge and working experience in: Double Column Cash Book Bank Reconciliation Ledger Maintenance Journal Entries and Journal Vouchers Receipt & Payment Statements Bill and Voucher Preparation VAT Challan Preparation Tax/TDS Calculation and Documentation Banking-related activities MS Word and MS Excel Preparation of financial statements and accounting reports Proper financial documentation and filing Responsibilities & Context Job Context : Universal Institute of Business and Technology (UIBT) is looking for a responsible, sincere and competent Accounts Officer for its SICIP Project. The selected candidate will be responsible for maintaining project accounts, financial records, banking transactions, tax and VAT documentation, vouchers, bills and financial statements in accordance with organizational and project requirements. Candidates having previous working experience in STEP, SEIP, SICIP or similar skills-development/donor-funded projects will be given preference. Key Responsibilities : The Accounts Officer will be responsible for the following: Maintain Double Column Cash Book accurately and regularly. Prepare Bank Reconciliation Statements and maintain proper bank transaction records. Maintain and update the Ledger Book and other accounting registers. Prepare and maintain all necessary Journal Entries/Journal Vouchers. Prepare Receipt & Payment Statements and other financial statements/reports as required. Handle all banking-related activities, including cheque preparation, deposits, withdrawals, bank correspondence and other routine banking work. Prepare Bills, Payment Vouchers, Receipt Vouchers, Journal Vouchers and other accounting documents. Verify bills, vouchers and supporting documents before processing payments. Maintain proper documentation and systematic filing of all financial and accounting records. Prepare and maintain VAT Challans and related VAT documentation. Calculate Tax/TDS and prepare relevant tax deduction documents and challans in accordance with applicable rules. Record all project-related financial transactions accurately and on a timely basis. Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports. Monitor project expenditures and maintain proper records against approved budget heads. Maintain records of staff/project advances and ensure timely adjustment and settlement. Assist in preparing documents and schedules required for internal and external audits. Ensure financial transactions comply with organizational policies and applicable SICIP/project financial procedures. Maintain confidentiality and security of financial information and documents. Coordinate with project, administration, procurement and training teams regarding financial and accounting matters. Perform any other accounts and finance-related duties assigned by the authority. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounting Accounting Data Entry Accounts and Finance Tax (VAT/ Customs Duty/ Income Tax) Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Savar)

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535526&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Masters MBA / M.Com in Accounting / Finance or CA (CC) completed / partially completed from a reputed public or private university. (Special preference will be given to candidates with professional degrees or specialized training in VAT, Taxation, or Inventory/Supply Chain Management). Additional Requirements Age 28 to 40 years Minimum 5 (five) years of practical hands-on experience in Accounts, Finance, VAT management, and Inventory/Warehouse operations in a reputed corporate house, trading, or manufacturing company. Note: Freshers or candidates with less than 5 years of experience are strictly not allowed to apply. Proven leadership experience in supervising inventory or warehouse staff. Sound command over computerized accounting software, ERP inventory modules, and advanced MS Excel. In-depth practical knowledge of VAT laws, Mushak 6.3, inventory valuation methods, return submission, and handling local VAT office matters. High integrity, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced growing business environment. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: We are a fast-growing commercial business enterprise. To manage our expanding financial operations, robust compliance, rigorous VAT management, and comprehensive inventory control, we are looking for a seasoned, proactive, and experienced Executive / Senior Executive - Accounts, VAT & Inventory. The ideal candidate will take charge of comprehensive financial reporting, full-cycle bank management, end-to-end VAT compliance (including direct liaison with VAT authorities), and overall inventory management along with supervising the inventory/warehouse team. If you have a strong background in commercial accounting, VAT handling, and supply chain inventory control, we welcome you to join our growing team in Mirpur, Dhaka. Key Responsibilities: Inventory Management & Team Supervision: Inventory Control & Monitoring: Oversee end-to-end inventory management, stock movement, receiving, dispatch, and periodic physical stock verification. Team Leadership: Manage, guide, and supervise the inventory and store-level personnel working under this department to ensure operational efficiency. Stock Reconciliation: Conduct regular reconciliation between physical stock, system records (ERP/software), and general ledger accounts to prevent shrinkage, discrepancies, or losses. Supply Chain Alignment: Coordinate closely with sales, procurement, and accounts teams to maintain optimum stock levels and streamline inventory flow for our growing business. Comprehensive Accounts & Financial Reporting: Financial Reporting: Prepare, analyze, and present accurate monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial reports (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) to management. Sales & Ledger Entries: Systematic entry and management of daily sales, purchases, expenses, and general ledger maintenance. Bank Reconciliation & Management: Comprehensive handling of all banking operations, including daily bank transactions, fund transfers, monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS), and physical/digital bank deposits. Cash Management: Rigorous day-to-day cash management, physical cash counting, systematic cash segregation, and strict financial controls to mitigate risk. Advanced VAT & Regulatory Compliance: Mushak 6.3 & VAT Management: Expert management, generation, and maintenance of Mushak 6.3, purchase-sale registers, and other statutory documents in alignment with inventory records as per the current VAT and SD Act. VAT Authority Liaison: Maintain a strong, professional working relationship and smooth communication with VAT circle officials, commissioners, and regulatory bodies for hassle-free compliance and resolution of assessments. Import & LC Operations: Handle accounts and VAT-related procedures for import shipments, assist in opening and managing Letters of Credit (LC), and manage related banking/customs documentation. Regulatory Updates: Keep the management updated regarding changes in tax, VAT, and financial compliance laws. Growing Business Support: Partner with management to streamline financial and inventory processes, strengthen internal controls, and support commercial scaling as a growing enterprise. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounts and Finance Financial Reporting VAT and Tax Letter Of Credit Compensation & Other Benefits Salary & Other Benefits (বেতন ও সুযোগ-সুবিধা): Salary: Negotiable (যোগ্যতার ভিত্তিতে আকর্ষণীয় ও আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে নির্ধারিত হবে) Salary Payment System: Paid on a regular monthly basis. Festival Bonus: 2 (Two) major festival bonuses. Salary Review: Yearly increment based on performance. Probation Period: 6 (Six) months. Other Benefits: Mobile bill / SIM allowance. Evening daily snacks facility at the office. Friendly, energetic work culture with immense career growth potential in a growing business. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Mirpur)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535577&fc.source_content: Requirements Education Diploma in Engineering Experience 1 to 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Architecture Firm, Interior Design, Building & Construction Materials Additional Requirements Age 22 to 36 years Only Male Minimum 1–2 years of relevant experience in photography, videography, content creation, social media, or a related field. Good understanding of DSLR/Mirrorless camera operation, composition, framing, lighting, and basic cinematography . Practical experience in video editing using software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut , or similar tools. Basic to advanced knowledge of Adobe Photoshop / Lightroom or equivalent photo-editing software. Experience in drone operation and aerial photography/videography will be highly valued. Good understanding of Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Reels, Shorts, and other digital platforms . Strong creative sense and the ability to present architectural and interior spaces attractively. Ability to work independently as well as with a team. Good communication and time-management skills. Willingness to travel to project locations when required. A portfolio/showreel of previous photography, videography, editing, or social media work is highly preferred. Preferred Candidate We are especially interested in candidates who: Have a strong passion for architecture, interior design, photography, videography, and visual storytelling . Can independently handle the complete process from shooting → editing → publishing . Understand how to create content that increases brand visibility and audience engagement . Can identify creative angles and capture visually appealing architectural details. Have previous experience working with architectural, interior, real estate, construction, or lifestyle brands . Responsibilities & Context FORMAT DESIGN is looking for a creative, energetic, and responsible Multimedia Content Creator & Social Media Executive who will be responsible for creating, collecting, editing, and publishing high-quality visual content from our architectural, interior design, and construction projects. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working both inside the office and on project sites , with a strong interest in photography, videography, drone shooting, video editing, and social media management. Job Responsibilities Visit ongoing and completed projects to collect professional photos and videos. Capture high-quality architectural, interior, construction, and project-site photography. Shoot professional videos using DSLR/Mirrorless cameras, smartphones, and other equipment . Operate drone cameras to capture aerial footage of projects, where legally permitted. Plan and create short-form video content for Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other platforms . Edit videos professionally for social media and promotional purposes. Perform basic photo editing, color correction, retouching, cropping, and image enhancement. Create engaging visual content that highlights our architectural designs, interiors, construction progress, completed projects, and company activities. Manage and maintain our social media content on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms . Write or coordinate suitable captions, titles, hashtags, and descriptions for posts and videos. Maintain an organized archive of project photos, videos, raw footage, and edited content. Follow current social media trends and develop new content ideas suitable for an architecture and design brand. Coordinate with the architecture, interior, and marketing teams to understand project highlights and create relevant content. Travel to project sites when required for photography, videography, and content creation. Skills & Expertise Adobe After Effects Adobe Photoshop Adobe Premiere Pro Capcut Other Relevant Skills Social Media Management Video Editing Content Development Compensation & Other Benefits T/A,Tour allowance,Mobile bill,Over time allowance Festival Bonus: 2 Salary Review: Yearly Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Competitive salary based on experience and skills. Performance-based incentives/benefits. Opportunity to work on diverse architectural and interior design projects. Opportunity to develop professional skills in photography, videography, drone content, video editing, and digital marketing. Friendly and creative working environment. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education Master of Commerce (MCom) in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration CA (CC) certification will be preferred. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, Spinning, Textile Additional Requirements Age 30 to 35 years Only Male Experience in Spinning Mills, manufacturing, garments/textile, trading, or corporate organizations will be preferred. Candidates with practical experience in ERP-based auditing and financial transaction review will receive preference. Strong knowledge of accounting and internal audit procedures. Good understanding of internal control, risk management, and compliance . Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and ERP software . Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Excellent attention to detail. Good communication and report-writing skills. Ability to work independently and under pressure. Willingness to visit factories, warehouses, branches, and other business locations when required. High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics. Responsibilities & Context Conduct regular financial, operational, compliance, and management audits as per the approved audit plan. Review accounting records, vouchers, bills, invoices, payments, receipts, and supporting documents. Verify cash, bank transactions, inventory, fixed assets, procurement, production, payroll, and other operational activities . Review and verify transactions and reports maintained in the company's ERP system . Check whether transactions are properly authorized and comply with company policies, SOPs, and applicable laws and regulations. Conduct physical verification of inventory, raw materials, finished goods, accessories, spare parts, fixed assets, and other company properties. Review payroll, attendance, overtime, bonus, leave, and employee-related payments where applicable. Identify financial irregularities, process gaps, control weaknesses, wastage, and potential fraud risks. Conduct surprise inspections/audits when required by management. Prepare detailed audit working papers and maintain proper audit documentation. Prepare clear and concise Internal Audit Reports highlighting observations, risks, root causes, and recommendations. Assist in special audits, investigations, fraud reviews, and management assignments when required. Coordinate with Finance, Accounts, HR, Commercial, Procurement, Production, Store, IT, and other departments during audit assignments. Perform any other duties assigned by the Head of Internal Audit, Management, and Board of Directors. Skills & Expertise Audit Internal Audit Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Attractive salary package. Festival bonuses and other benefits as per company policy. Professional development and career growth opportunities. Other facilities as per organizational policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Group of Companies, Spinning, Textile Additional Requirements Age 30 to 35 years Only Male Experience in Spinning Mills, manufacturing, garments/textile, trading, or corporate organizations will be preferred. Candidates with practical experience in ERP-based auditing and financial transaction review will receive preference. Strong knowledge of accounting and internal audit procedures. Good understanding of internal control, risk management, and compliance . Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and ERP software . Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Excellent attention to detail. Good communication and report-writing skills. Ability to work independently and under pressure. Willingness to visit factories, warehouses, branches, and other business locations when required. High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics. Responsibilities & Context Conduct regular financial, operational, compliance, and management audits as per the approved audit plan. Review accounting records, vouchers, bills, invoices, payments, receipts, and supporting documents. Verify cash, bank transactions, inventory, fixed assets, procurement, production, payroll, and other operational activities . Review and verify transactions and reports maintained in the company's ERP system . Check whether transactions are properly authorized and comply with company policies, SOPs, and applicable laws and regulations. Conduct physical verification of inventory, raw materials, finished goods, accessories, spare parts, fixed assets, and other company properties. Review payroll, attendance, overtime, bonus, leave, and employee-related payments where applicable. Identify financial irregularities, process gaps, control weaknesses, wastage, and potential fraud risks. Conduct surprise inspections/audits when required by management. Prepare detailed audit working papers and maintain proper audit documentation. Prepare clear and concise Internal Audit Reports highlighting observations, risks, root causes, and recommendations. Assist in special audits, investigations, fraud reviews, and management assignments when required. Coordinate with Finance, Accounts, HR, Commercial, Procurement, Production, Store, IT, and other departments during audit assignments. Perform any other duties assigned by the Head of Internal Audit, Management, and Board of Directors. Skills & Expertise Audit Internal Audit Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Attractive salary package. Festival bonuses and other benefits as per company policy. Professional development and career growth opportunities. Other facilities as per organizational policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka

Strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and analytical skills, with a proven ability to build relationships, identify market opportunities, and drive business growth. Responsibilities & Context United Commercial Bank PLC (UCB) , one of Bangladesh’s leading first-generation private commercial banks, is seeking dynamic, result-oriented, and customer-focused professionals to join the Agri & MFI Business Team under its SME & Agri Banking Division as Agri Sales Officer . In this key field-level role, the incumbent will be responsible for expanding agricultural lending, sourcing quality Agri-SME proposals, driving customer acquisition, and strengthening portfolio monitoring. The position plays a critical role in achieving business growth targets while delivering financial solutions to grassroots communities across the country. Key Job Responsibilities: Achieve business targets for loan disbursement, recovery/collection, and deposit mobilization. Organize weekly Uthan Boithak sessions in different locations in coordination with Branch officials, and submit relevant reports. Conduct regular meetings and develop strong relationships with government and local stakeholders—including UAO, ULO, UFO, and community leaders—to facilitate business development and operational support. Identify new business opportunities through market visits, field surveys, and customer engagement initiatives to ensure sustainable portfolio growth. Source quality Agri-SME loan proposals from Branches, Sub-branches, Agent Banking Outlets, and business communities. Ensure superior customer service and maintain strong relationships to enhance client satisfaction and business retention. Provide end-to-end credit support, including pre-disbursement visits, loan proposal analysis, coordination with CRM and other stakeholders, oversight of loan documentation, and post-disbursement monitoring. Responsibilities & Context
United Commercial Bank PLC (UCB), one of Bangladesh’s leading first-generation private commercial banks, is seeking dynamic, result-oriented, and customer-focused professionals to join the Agri & MFI Business Team under its SME & Agri Banking Division as Agri Sales Officer.
In this key field-level role, the incumbent will be responsible for expanding agricultural lending, sourcing quality Agri-SME proposals, driving customer acquisition, and strengthening portfolio monitoring. The position plays a critical role in achieving business growth targets while delivering financial solutions to grassroots communities across the country.
Key Job Responsibilities:
Achieve business targets for loan disbursement, recovery/collection, and deposit mobilization.
Organize weekly Uthan Boithak sessions in different locations in coordination with Branch officials, and submit relevant reports.
Conduct regular meetings and develop strong relationships with government and local stakeholders—including UAO, ULO, UFO, and community leaders—to facilitate business development and operational support.
Identify new business opportunities through market visits, field surveys, and customer engagement initiatives to ensure sustainable portfolio growth.
Source quality Agri-SME loan proposals from Branches, Sub-branches, Agent Banking Outlets, and business communities.
Ensure superior customer service and maintain strong relationships to enhance client satisfaction and business retention.
Provide end-to-end credit support, including pre-disbursement visits, loan proposal analysis, coordination with CRM and other stakeholders, oversight of loan documentation, and post-disbursement monitoring.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535754&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Additional Requirements Age 21 to 26 years Responsibilities & Context Assist the admissions team in counselling prospective students and parents regarding study abroad opportunities, admission requirements, and application procedures. Support the processing of student applications, including document collection, data entry, and follow-ups to ensure timely submissions. Maintain and update student records, CRM systems, and admission-related databases accurately. Coordinate with counsellors and partner universities to track application status and communicate updates to students. Support marketing activities such as promoting services through social media, phone calls, emails, and in-office engagement. Assist in planning and executing marketing campaigns, seminars, education fairs, and promotional events at Banani and Dhanmondi offices. Handle front-desk queries and provide basic information to walk-in students and guardians in a professional manner. Conduct market research on universities, courses, scholarships, and competitor activities to support marketing strategies. Help create basic marketing content such as flyers, posters, social media captions, and student success posts. Collaborate with the marketing team to generate leads and convert inquiries into potential applicants. Perform other administrative and coordination tasks as assigned by the admissions or marketing supervisors. Skills & Expertise Computer Literacy Other Relevant Skills CRM Marketing Visa Processing Compensation & Other Benefits There is an opportunity to secure a full-time permanent job after successful completion of the internship period. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Banani, Dhanmondi)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Marketing Bachelor’s degree or above in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field. Additional Requirements Age At most 35 years Proven B2B sales and team-management experience; experience in electronics, commercial display, ICT, AV, LED, signage, or related solution sales will be an advantage. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, presentation, and customer-development skills. Able to work under pressure, take ownership, and consistently deliver sales targets. Energetic, proactive, disciplined, and result-oriented. Age below 35; exceptional candidates may receive age relaxation. Graduates of reputed universities will receive preference. Responsibilities & Context Brand: MANGO – Smart Display Solutions Job Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh ARISTRON LTD. is seeking an energetic, target-driven, and experienced Sales Manager to lead our Commercial Display Solutions sales team. The successful candidate will build B2B business, lead sales representatives, achieve revenue targets, and expand the MANGO Smart Display Solutions market across Bangladesh. Key Responsibilities Lead, coach, and monitor the performance of the sales team. Set sales plans, assign targets, and ensure timely achievement of monthly and quarterly KPIs. Develop new B2B customers and maintain relationships with corporate clients, retailers, restaurants, hotels, schools, hospitals, developers, agencies, and system integrators. Conduct customer meetings, product demonstrations, negotiations, and key-account visits. Guide the team in lead follow-up, quotation preparation, proposal presentation, order closing, delivery coordination, and payment collection. Monitor the sales pipeline, team activity, market trends, competitor pricing, and customer feedback. Submit accurate sales forecasts, performance reports, and market-development plans to management. Work closely with marketing, technical, operations, and finance teams. Maintain pricing discipline and obtain approval for exceptional discounts. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Sales & Marketing Sales Target Achievement Consumer Durables - Sales & Marketing Compensation & Other Benefits BDT 50,000 base salary + KPI incentive + team sales commission Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor’s degree in industrial & production engineering (IPE), Textile Engineering, or a relevant discipline.
raw_source_fields.age: 25 to 30 years Responsibilities & Context Handle day-to-day procurement activities for factory requirements. Procure garment accessories and packing materials such as zipper, label, thread, poly, carton, hangtag, tape, and other related items from local suppliers. Procure machine spare parts, engineering items, consumables, and other factory supplies from local markets and suppliers. Source new suppliers and maintain good relationships with existing suppliers. Collect and compare quotations and negotiate price, quality, payment terms, and delivery schedules. Prepare Purchase Orders (PO) and ensure timely delivery of materials. Ensure materials are purchased according to approved specification, quality, quantity, and required delivery date. Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery and resolve supply-related issues. Maintain proper records of quotations, purchase orders, supplier information, invoices, and procurement documents. Monitor purchase costs and support cost-effective procurement. Skills & Expertise Local and Foreign Purchase Purchase/ Procurement Supply Chain and Procurement Other Relevant Skills Purchase Purchase orders

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535868&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Science (BSc) in CSE/CSIT, Electrical, Related Field Professional Certification or Training will be given preference. Experience At most 1 year Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age At least 22 years Educational Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Fresh graduates with relevant academic projects, internship, or practical QA experience are encouraged to apply. Required Skills & Knowledge Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, usability, and system testing concepts. Ability to prepare test cases, test scenarios, test data, and test reports. Ability to identify, reproduce, document, and track software bugs effectively. Good understanding of bug life cycle and defect management processes. Basic knowledge of API testing and HTTP methods is an advantage. Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts is an advantage. Basic understanding of web applications, browsers, client-server architecture, and REST APIs. Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Git, Postman, or similar QA/testing tools is an advantage. Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum software development methodology. Good analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. Good communication and documentation skills. Ability to work collaboratively with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Managers, and other team members. Willingness to learn new technologies, testing tools, and QA methodologies. Responsibilities & Context Review business and functional requirements to understand expected system behavior and testing scope. Prepare and execute test cases, test scenarios, and test scripts based on defined requirements. Perform functional, regression, integration, usability, and basic compatibility testing. Identify, reproduce, document, and report software bugs with clear steps, expected results, and actual results. Verify bug fixes and perform retesting to ensure reported issues are properly resolved. Validate system workflows, business rules, data accuracy, calculations, forms, reports, and user interactions. Perform testing across different user roles, permissions, and access levels. Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support and validate system functionality from an end-user perspective. Maintain test cases, test results, bug reports, testing documentation, and issue tracking records. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, implementation teams, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve issues. Participate in requirement reviews and provide feedback on potential functional gaps, usability issues, and edge cases. Support release testing, deployment verification, and post-release validation when required. Track reported issues and follow up with relevant teams until successful resolution. Continuously learn and apply software testing methodologies, QA processes, and industry best practices. Perform any other responsibilities assigned by the supervisor or management. Compensation & Other Benefits Weekly 2 holidays,T/A,Mobile bill Lunch Facilities: Full Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Bachelor of Commerce (BCom) in Accounting, Finance, Accounting & Information System Master of Business Administration (MBA) Master of Commerce (MCom) Master of Business Management (MBM) in Accounting or Finance is heavily preferred or required by many employers Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Logistic/Courier/Air Express Companies, Security Service Additional Requirements A strong commitment to MRDI’s vision, mission and values. Updated knowledge and skills on financial management of development programmers and projects. Advanced skills in maintaining books of account Skills on updated accounting software. Able to communicate both in Bangla and English. Strong analytical/problem solving skills. Responsibilities & Context Tax and VAT Operations Ensure accurate deduction of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) and VAT Deducted at Source (VDS) on vendor and service provider payments. Prepare and submit monthly VAT returns (such as Mushak-9.1) and issue withholding certificates like Mushak-6.6. Manage monthly deposits of tax and VAT obligations to the government exchequer. Maintain statutory VAT books, input-output coefficients, and proper Mushak challans for product dispatch and receipt. Handle routine correspondences, workings, and negotiations with local VAT and tax circle offices. Internal Audit & F&A Compliance Support and coordinate internal and statutory audits by preparing required schedules, ledgers, and financial documentation. Strengthen internal control processes across general ledger, accounts payable, and financial reporting to mitigate risk. Review daily voucher postings, bills, and payment entries for accuracy and compliance with company policies. Monitor financial exposures and operational activities to detect and prevent discrepancies or non-compliance. Follow up on audit findings and ensure management implements recommended corrective actions. General Financial & Accounts (F&A) Duties Maintain up-to-date books of accounts using accounting software (e.g., Tally, SAP, or QuickBooks). Perform monthly bank reconciliations and maintain fixed asset registers with proper asset coding. Assist management in preparing periodic financial reports, budgeting workings, and tax assessment schedules Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

raw_source_fields.education: Fresh Graduates with strong communication and sales ability may also be considered.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1535920&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Fresh Graduates with strong communication and sales ability may also be considered. Experience 1 to 3 years Additional Requirements Experience: 1–3 years in outdoor sales, field marketing, business development, travel sales or a related field preferred. Excellent communication and convincing/presentation skills. Comfortable traveling throughout the assigned area. Must be energetic, proactive and comfortable meeting new people. Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills. Ability to generate leads independently rather than waiting for customers to come to the office. Target-oriented and capable of working with monthly KPIs. Basic knowledge of travel/visa/ticketing services is an advantage. Good command of Bangla; conversational English preferred. Smartphone and basic computer/WhatsApp/email skills required. Must be willing to perform regular outdoor/field work. Responsibilities & Context Main Responsibilities: Conduct daily outdoor marketing and business-development activities. Visit corporate offices, educational institutions, businesses, shops, organizations and potential client locations. Generate new leads for: Air tickets, Visa processing, Tour packages, Hotel bookings, Travel-related services Meet potential customers and explain the company's services and packages. Develop relationships with corporate clients, business owners, institutions and other potential partners. Collect qualified customer leads and forward them to the relevant internal team. Follow up with leads through phone, WhatsApp and in-person meetings. Arrange meetings between potential clients and the company's sales/visa/ticketing team. Participate in exhibitions, travel fairs, seminars, promotional events and corporate visits. Identify new areas and markets where the company can acquire customers. Develop referral relationships with relevant businesses and partners. Maintain a daily report of visits, meetings, leads and conversions. Achieve agreed monthly lead-generation and sales targets. Monitor competitor activities and report market feedback to management. Represent the company professionally during all external meetings. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh

Validating the financial data declared by the applicants and preparing income statements/balance sheets from raw data. Ensuring authenticity of the loan application documents. Preparing credit appraisal memo in compliance with the credit policy of IDLC Finance and the regulations of Bangladesh Bank. Ensuring close coordination among the key stakeholders at branch level (Credit Risk Management, SME Business Unit, Credit Administration, and Special Asset Management). Analyzing the branch portfolio periodically and performing case study on the default clients. Experience: Experienced candidates from reputed banks and NBFIs with experience in credit risk management will be preferred. However, freshers are highly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities & Context National Energy Services Limited (NESL), founded in 2004, is one of the leading Professional Employer Organizations (PEO) and human resources outsourcing providers in Bangladesh. We deliver end-to-end HR solutions across a wide range of industries, including energy, construction, oil & gas, telecommunications, IT, engineering, and manufacturing. Serving both multinational corporations and top local business houses, NESL is recognized for its expertise in sourcing, managing, and optimizing talent across diverse sectors. NESL now invites applications from competent candidates for the post of Administration Management Service - VIP Chinese Canteen for one of it’s Clients in Telecommunication sector. Responsible for project management of the VIP VIP canteen management regulations Promotion and Notification of VIP canteen Safety inspection VIP canteen Satisfaction Survey VIP canteen Cost Analysis Assume full responsibility for internal client dining and hospitality services, including the end-to-end coordination of banquets and business meals. Manage the selection, upgrading, and maintenance of the dining area, tableware, and supporting facilities to ensure they meet hospitality standards. Establish service standards and conduct training on hospitality etiquette for service staff; coordinate between the kitchen and front-of-house operations to ensure food quality and smooth service workflows. Address personalized client requests, maintain order on-site, and enhance overall hospitality satisfaction. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1536280&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Degree or professional training in IT, Computer Science, Web Development, SEO, Digital Marketing, or a related field is preferred. Additional Requirements Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a hands-on digital and technology professional who can independently manage multiple digital channels and solve technical and marketing-related challenges. The candidate should have practical knowledge and experience in: SEO & Google Ranking Digital Marketing Social Media Management Meta / Facebook Marketing & Ads Google Analytics & Search Console Website Management & Optimization WordPress or similar CMS platforms Keyword Research & Competitor Analysis Content & Conversion Optimization Google Business Profile / Local SEO Meta Business Suite & Ads Manager AI Tools, AI Search & Generative AI Web Analytics & Performance Reporting Basic IT, Database & System Administration ERP / Office Management Software Website Security, Backup & Data Protection What We Expect Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. Strong understanding of current SEO, digital marketing, social media, Meta advertising, and AI trends. Ability to combine marketing, technology, analytics, and business objectives into practical solutions. Strong communication, reporting, documentation, and teamwork skills. A proactive mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and implement improvements without constant supervision. Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new digital and AI technologies. Practical experience in SEO, Google Ranking, Organic Traffic, and Website Management is highly preferred. Freshers may apply if they have relevant professional training/certification and practical knowledge. However, candidates with hands-on SEO experience will receive preference. Preferred Relevant professional certifications in SEO, Google, Meta, Digital Marketing, Analytics, or IT. Experience managing multiple company websites or brands. Experience with paid advertising and lead-generation campaigns. Experience with ERP, CRM, office management, or business management software. Experience with AI SEO / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) will be an advantage. Proven portfolio or measurable results in SEO, digital marketing, social media, website growth, or paid campaigns will be highly valued. Strong practical SEO experience is highly important. Good knowledge of Google Search, Search Console, Analytics, Keyword Research, On-Page and Technical SEO. Experience with WordPress/CMS, HTML, CSS, hosting, SSL, backup, and website security. Knowledge of AI tools, AI Search, LLMs, and AI information optimization is an advantage. Experience in ERP Software Maintenance, Database Management, Troubleshooting, and System Security will be highly preferred. Good English communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Responsibilities & Context Job Summary BIA Group is looking for a highly skilled and result-oriented Web, SEO, Digital Marketing & IT Specialist to lead and manage our digital presence, website performance, SEO, social media platforms, Meta ecosystem, AI visibility, and internal technology systems. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in SEO, Digital Marketing, Meta/Facebook, Social Media Management, Website Management, Google tools, AI platforms, analytics, and IT/ERP systems . This role requires someone who can independently identify problems, implement solutions, analyze performance, and continuously improve BIA Group’s digital visibility and technology infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Website & Web Management Manage, maintain, update, optimize, and secure BIA Group and its associated companies’ websites. Ensure websites are fast, mobile-friendly, user-friendly, technically sound, and search-engine optimized. Manage website content, landing pages, images, metadata, internal linking, forms, integrations, and website security. Monitor website performance, uptime, backups, data protection, and technical issues. Identify and resolve website errors and coordinate technical improvements when required. SEO & Google Search Develop and execute effective On-Page, Technical, Local, and Off-Page SEO strategies . Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, search-intent analysis, and content-gap analysis. Improve Google rankings, organic traffic, website authority, visibility, and conversion opportunities. Manage and monitor Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, and other relevant SEO tools . Optimize website structure, content, URLs, schema, metadata, images, page speed, internal links, and technical SEO elements. Monitor search trends, algorithm changes, competitors, and industry developments and implement appropriate SEO strategies. Digital Marketing & Social Media Plan, execute, manage, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across relevant online platforms. Manage and grow BIA Group’s Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other social media platforms . Develop social media strategies focused on brand awareness, engagement, reach, lead generation, and business growth. Create and optimize content strategies, campaign plans, promotional activities, and performance reports. Analyze audience behavior, engagement, reach, leads, conversions, and campaign performance. Meta / Facebook Marketing Manage Meta Business Suite, Facebook Pages, Ads Manager, Business Manager, Pixel/Conversions API, audiences, campaigns, and reporting . Plan, launch, monitor, test, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns. Perform audience research, retargeting, remarketing, campaign optimization, and performance analysis. Monitor advertising performance and continuously improve CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rate, and overall campaign efficiency. AI & Online Visibility Maintain and improve BIA Group’s visibility and accuracy across AI-powered search, AI assistants, knowledge platforms, and emerging AI discovery channels . Ensure company, brand, service, and business information is accurate, consistent, and properly structured across relevant online platforms. Explore and implement useful AI tools and automation to improve marketing, content, research, reporting, customer engagement, and business operations. Stay updated with developments in AI Search, Generative AI, AI SEO/GEO, and digital marketing technologies . ERP, IT & Office Management Systems Maintain, monitor, troubleshoot, and improve BIA Group’s Dynamic ERP & Office Management Software . Manage system users, access permissions, data, backups, security, and basic database-related requirements. Identify software issues, coordinate fixes, and support required feature updates and system improvements. Provide technical support to internal users and ensure smooth operation of essential digital systems. Maintain proper backup, security, access control, and data protection procedures. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Monitoring Prepare regular reports covering SEO, Google ranking, organic traffic, website performance, social media growth, Meta campaigns, leads, AI visibility, and ERP/system status . Analyze data and provide actionable recommendations for improving digital performance and business growth. Track KPIs and continuously evaluate the effectiveness of digital marketing and technology initiatives. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a hands-on digital and technology professional who can independently manage multiple digital channels and solve technical and marketing-related challenges. The candidate should have practical knowledge and experience in: SEO & Google Ranking Digital Marketing Social Media Management Meta / Facebook Marketing & Ads Google Analytics & Search Console Website Management & Optimization WordPress or similar CMS platforms Keyword Research & Competitor Analysis Content & Conversion Optimization Google Business Profile / Local SEO Meta Business Suite & Ads Manager AI Tools, AI Search & Generative AI Web Analytics & Performance Reporting Basic IT, Database & System Administration ERP / Office Management Software Website Security, Backup & Data Protection What We Expect Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. Strong understanding of current SEO, digital marketing, social media, Meta advertising, and AI trends. Ability to combine marketing, technology, analytics, and business objectives into practical solutions. Strong communication, reporting, documentation, and teamwork skills. A proactive mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and implement improvements without constant supervision. Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new digital and AI technologies. Preferred Relevant professional certifications in SEO, Google, Meta, Digital Marketing, Analytics, or IT. Experience managing multiple company websites or brands. Experience with paid advertising and lead-generation campaigns. Experience with ERP, CRM, office management, or business management software. Experience with AI SEO / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) will be an advantage. Proven portfolio or measurable results in SEO, digital marketing, social media, website growth, or paid campaigns will be highly valued. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Facebook marketing Social Media Management Artificial intelligence (AI) Compensation & Other Benefits Salary: BDT 15,000–25,000/month For Qualified Candidates: Negotiable based on experience, skills, and suitability Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Management, Marketing Experience At least 3 years Additional Requirements Age 25 to 40 years Only Male Sales Skills : Proven experience in achieving sales targets and developing sales strategies. Team Management: Ability to supervise, motivate, and coordinate a sales team. Marketing Knowledge: Basic understanding of digital marketing, promotional campaigns, customer acquisition, and market analysis. Communication: Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Reporting: Ability to prepare and analyze sales reports, targets, achievements, and market feedback. Ensure professional behavior and discipline within the team. Performance-based salary increment opportunities. Friendly and professional working environment Career growth and long-term opportunity within the company. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Gender Only males are allowed to apply. Job Location Dhaka (Dhanmondi)

Responsibilities & Context About the Company Import Mart Limited is a Bangladesh-based e-commerce company specializing in 100% authentic imported products across multiple categories. We are looking for a confident, presentable, creative, and communication-oriented female professional who can represent our brand in front of the camera, create engaging product videos, communicate with customers, and contribute innovative ideas to support business growth. Key Responsibilities On-Camera Product Presentation & Content Creation Present company products confidently in promotional videos, product demonstrations, and social media Reels. Explain product features, benefits, and usage clearly and engagingly. Create video content for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other digital platforms. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop video concepts, scripts, and promotional content. Maintain a professional on-camera appearance, confident body language, and engaging presentation style. Participate in product photography and brand-related promotional activities. Customer Communication & Order Management Communicate professionally with customers through phone calls, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and other company channels. Respond to product inquiries regarding pricing, availability, features, and order information. Assist customers in selecting suitable products according to their needs. Follow up with interested customers and confirm orders. Coordinate with the operations team for order processing and delivery updates. Maintain positive customer relationships and proper records of customer inquiries. Business Development & Growth Planning Generate creative and practical ideas to improve brand awareness, customer engagement, and sales. Work with the marketing and management teams to develop promotional strategies and business growth initiatives. Identify new product opportunities, content trends, and customer engagement strategies. Suggest improvements to product presentation, marketing activities, and customer communication. Contribute to marketing campaigns, promotional activities, and brand-building initiatives. Competitor Analysis & Market Research Monitor competitor websites, social media pages, product offerings, and promotional activities. Compare competitor product prices with Import Mart Limited's selling prices. Prepare regular price comparison reports and share market insights with management. Research customer preferences, trending products, and emerging market opportunities. Identify competitor marketing strategies and suggest improvements to strengthen the company's market position. Skills & Expertise Business Development Competitor Analysis Content Creation Customer Service Customer Support Market Research Sales Social Media Marketing Other Relevant Skills Content Creation Video Editing Facebook Live Presenter

Proven experience with ERP and business systems such as SAP, Oracle, D365 or equivalent, including system-process and application-control reviews. Practical knowledge of host-to-host bank transactions, online payment controls, fraud-risk assessment, digital evidence, system logs and cybersecurity controls. CISA cybersecurity certification or demonstrated specialist experience will receive preference. Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Python, audit analytics, AI tools, process mining or automation will be an added advantage. Responsibilities & Context Report directly to the Internal Audit Manager and independently conduct forensic, system-process, technology and data-driven audits. Investigate suspected fraud, digital-payment irregularities, cyber incidents, policy breaches and control overrides while preserving evidence and confidentiality. Review host-to-host banking, online payments, payment approvals, maker-checker controls, beneficiary changes, bank interfaces and transaction reconciliations. Assess IT general controls and application controls, including user access, segregation of duties, privileged activities, change management, interfaces and system logs. Understand software workflows, business logic, configurations and potential bugs; identify control weaknesses and recommend preventive and detective controls. Evaluate cybersecurity exposure relating to phishing, business-email compromise, unauthorized access, online scams, data leakage and payment fraud. Apply AI, continuous auditing, process mining, anomaly detection and data analytics to identify unusual transactions, patterns and emerging risks. Prepare defensible forensic reports, quantify control impact where supportable, coordinate remediation and track closure of agreed actions. raw_source_fields.education: BBA/MBA from a reputed university. Preferred majors: Marketing, Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics or related disciplines.
raw_source_fields.age: At least 24 years Strong analytical and numerical skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and office suite. Good understanding of retail promotions, pricing, and sales analysis. Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights. Good understanding of retail/FMCG market trends and consumer behavior. Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively. Good command of written and spoken English. Responsibilities & Context Job Purpose: The Senior Officer, Promotion is responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and analyzing promotional campaigns across Alfamart stores. The role focuses on selecting products based on sales, stock availability, and business objectives; monitoring promotional performance; managing supplier-funded promotion claims; and providing data-driven insights to improve promotion effectiveness, sales, and store footfall. Key Responsibilities: Select and recommend products for promotional campaigns based on sales performance, stock availability, business objectives, and category priorities. Plan and execute weekly and monthly promotional campaigns across Alfamart stores in coordination with relevant departments. Coordinate with the Merchandising/Category team regarding promotional mechanics, product selection, discount structure, campaign requirements, and promotional support. Prepare promotion proposals, campaign calendars, promotional trackers, and related documentation for timely execution of campaigns. Monitor and analyze promotional performance including sales uplift, quantity/value growth, promotion vs. non-promotion sales, store-wise performance, SKU-wise performance, stock availability, and sell-through. Prepare post-promotion analysis reports highlighting campaign performance, key findings, gaps, and recommendations for future promotions. Prepare and maintain supplier claim reports and debit notes for supplier-funded promotions and promotional campaigns. Coordinate with Finance and Merchandising teams to ensure supplier claims are properly documented, reconciled, and recovered within the required timeline. Maintain accurate promotion databases, campaign trackers, historical records, and supporting documents for effective monitoring and future reference. Develop and maintain Excel-based reports and dashboards to monitor promotional performance and support management decision-making. Monitor promotional execution across stores and coordinate with Store Operations to identify and resolve campaign-related issues. Work closely with Merchandising/Category, Commercial, Finance, and Store Operations teams to ensure smooth and effective promotional execution. Identify opportunities to improve promotional effectiveness, sales performance, customer engagement, and store footfall through data analysis and market insights. Conduct market and competitor research to identify emerging promotional trends, customer preferences, and competitive activities. Recommend new and creative promotional mechanisms and campaign ideas based on market trends, customer behavior, business requirements, and historical campaign performance. Perform any other promotion-related duties and analysis assigned by the management to support business objectives. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Consumer Behavior Understanding Sales Analysis promotional activities Campaign Management Team Coordination Competitor Analysis

Key Responsibilities: Select and recommend products for promotional campaigns based on sales performance, stock availability, business objectives, and category priorities. Plan and execute weekly and monthly promotional campaigns across Alfamart stores in coordination with relevant departments. Coordinate with the Merchandising/Category team regarding promotional mechanics, product selection, discount structure, campaign requirements, and promotional support. Prepare promotion proposals, campaign calendars, promotional trackers, and related documentation for timely execution of campaigns. Monitor and analyze promotional performance including sales uplift, quantity/value growth, promotion vs. non-promotion sales, store-wise performance, SKU-wise performance, stock availability, and sell-through. Prepare post-promotion analysis reports highlighting campaign performance, key findings, gaps, and recommendations for future promotions. Prepare and maintain supplier claim reports and debit notes for supplier-funded promotions and promotional campaigns. Coordinate with Finance and Merchandising teams to ensure supplier claims are properly documented, reconciled, and recovered within the required timeline. Maintain accurate promotion databases, campaign trackers, historical records, and supporting documents for effective monitoring and future reference. Develop and maintain Excel-based reports and dashboards to monitor promotional performance and support management decision-making. Monitor promotional execution across stores and coordinate with Store Operations to identify and resolve campaign-related issues. Work closely with Merchandising/Category, Commercial, Finance, and Store Operations teams to ensure smooth and effective promotional execution. Identify opportunities to improve promotional effectiveness, sales performance, customer engagement, and store footfall through data analysis and market insights. Conduct market and competitor research to identify emerging promotional trends, customer preferences, and competitive activities. Recommend new and creative promotional mechanisms and campaign ideas based on market trends, customer behavior, business requirements, and historical campaign performance. Perform any other promotion-related duties and analysis assigned by the management to support business objectives. উন্নত করার জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় কাজ করা। ডিজিটাল মার্কেটিং ফেসবুক, ইনস্টাগ্রাম, ইউটিউব এবং অন্যান্য অনলাইন প্ল্যাটফর্মে মার্কেটিং কার্যক্রমে সহায়তা করা। প্রচারণার ফলাফল পর্যবেক্ষণ ও রিপোর্ট তৈরি করা। jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1536636&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education MBA/MBM/Masters/Four years’ Bachelor Degree (preferably Business) from UGC approved universities having no 3rd class in academic records. Candidate having minimum 16 years of schooling will be eligible. Candidates having professional degree/certification like CIA, CPAI, CISA, CDCS, CSAA etc. will be given preference. Experience At least 2 years Additional Requirements Minimum 02 years of work experience in ICC Division (Audit & Inspection Unit, Compliance & Monitoring) of in any commercial banks/ financial institution. Working experience in various desks (GB, Credit & Foreign Trade) in Bank’s branches will be preferable. In case of candidate from CA firm, he/she must have sufficient experience on Banks Audit & Inspection. Responsibilities & Context Conducting internal comprehensive audit, compliance review, and monitoring activities across branches and divisions. Examine financial transactions, operational processes, and internal controls to ensure compliance with policies and regulatory requirements. Support the audit team in identifying risks, irregularities, and areas for improvement. Participate in follow-up reviews to ensure corrective actions are implemented. Preparing audit working papers, compliance reports, and related documentation. Monitor adherence to the Bank’s internal control systems and regulatory guidelines. Perform any other audit, compliance, or monitoring-related tasks as assigned by the Audit Division. Preparation of Annual Health Report, Monitoring & Review of internal Control tools (DCFCL, LDCL, etc.). Perform task related to Audit Committee of Board (ACB). Preparing yearly audit plan based on Risk Based Supervision (RBS). Carryout special investigation, inspection on various issues time to time, surprise check in sensitive areas. Ranking all branches in terms of approved risk grading matrix. Perform any other duties assigned by the supervisor/Head of ICC/Management to support the Bank’s operation. Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive compensation package will be offered to the deserving candidates selected for the positions based on the experience and competency. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1536645&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education MBA/MBM/Masters/Four years’ Bachelor Degree (preferably Business) from UGC approved universities having no 3rd class in academic records. Candidate having minimum 16 years of schooling will be eligible. Experience At least 1 year Additional Requirements Minimum 01 year of work experience as relationship officer or relevant experience in a commercial banks/ financial institution. Responsibilities & Context Identify, acquire and onboard new retail & SME clients to expand the bank’s customer base, ensuring alignment with the bank’s business strategy. Build, nurture, and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with retail & SME clients, ensuring superior service, satisfaction and retention. Drive business by expanding the customer base and achieving targets for loans & deposit by cross-selling and up-selling appropriate banking products and services tailored to client needs. Conduct regular visits to existing and prospective clients to strengthen relationships, explore opportunities and provide proactive solutions. Address and resolve client concerns promptly, ensuring a seamless, one-stop banking experience. Perform financial analysis, assess creditworthiness and prepare credit proposals to support sound lending decisions. Monitor portfolio quality, minimize NPLs to ensure sustainable asset growth and asset quality, enforce adherence to bank policies, credit standards and regulatory guidelines. Prepare and review credit proposal/ call reports; maintain accurate MIS; and ensure proper documentation and archiving of client files. Ensure smooth execution of banking operations (account services, fund transfers, e-GP, etc.) with adherence to AML/KYC standards. Liaise effectively with internal teams (credit, operations, compliance, audit, etc.) and external stakeholders to ensure smooth operations and timely service delivery. Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by management to support the smooth functioning of the branch. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Client Acquisition Credit Risk Assessment Financial Analysis Regulatory Compliance Relationship Management Compensation & Other Benefits Attractive compensation package will be offered to the deserving candidates selected for the positions based on the experience and competency. Requirements Education Minimum Bachelor’s degree/Honours/HSC/Diploma in Agriculture, IT, Design, Communication, Marketing or a relevant discipline. Candidates with strong practical experience may also be considered. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Agro based firms (incl. Agro Processing/Seed/GM) Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in media, communication, digital marketing, graphic design or a related field. Strong creativity, communication skills, initiative and ability to work independently. Willingness to travel for field activities, product shooting and promotional events when required. Graphic Design: Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator is required. Video Editing: Basic to intermediate video editing skills for Facebook, YouTube and other digital platforms. Social Media: Practical experience in managing Facebook pages and YouTube channels, including content planning and audience engagement. Industry Knowledge: Basic knowledge of agriculture, seeds or agribusiness will be considered an additional advantage. Responsibilities & Context Life Seeds, a reputed seed company, is inviting applications from qualified, creative and motivated professionals for the position of Media & Communication Officer at its Head Office in Dhaka. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the company’s digital presence, creating engaging content and supporting brand communication initiatives. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Manage and regularly update the company’s Facebook page, including posts, product information, photographs and promotional content regularly. Create, manage and grow the company’s official YouTube channel and regularly publish high-quality video content. Develop creative promotional materials such as banners, posters, leaflets, digital creatives and other marketing communication assets. Respond to customer comments and messages professionally and maintain a positive and consistent brand image across social media platforms. Plan, shoot and edit photographs and videos of company activities, products, field demonstrations and promotional events as required. Coordinate with the Marketing, Sales, R&D and other relevant teams to support digital campaigns and communication activities. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Digital Marketing (Social Media Marketing) Social Media Management Adobe Photoshop Adobe Illustrator Facebook marketing Compensation & Other Benefits Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience. Two annual festival bonuses. Other benefits as per company policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

raw_source_fields.age: At most 45 years যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতা: কৃষক সম্পৃক্ততা, ক্ষুদ্রঋণ বা কৃষি ব্যবসা সহায়তায় ১–৩ বছরের বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা। ERP বা ডিজিটাল ডেটা সংগ্রহ টুল ব্যবহারের অভিজ্ঞতা অতিরিক্ত যোগ্যতা হিসেবে গণ্য হবে। কৃষি মূল্য শৃঙ্খল ও গ্রামীণ অর্থব্যবস্থা সম্পর্কে ভালো ধারণা থাকতে হবে। দক্ষতা ও সক্ষমতা: যোগাযোগ ও আন্তঃব্যক্তিক দক্ষতা। সময় ব্যবস্থাপনা ও একাধিক কাজ একসাথে সম্পাদনের সক্ষমতা। আর্থিক লেনদেন ও রিপোর্টিংয়ে মোবাইল অ্যাপ ব্যবহারে দক্ষতা। সততা, দায়িত্ববোধ, বিস্তারিত মনোযোগ এবং লক্ষ্য অর্জনে অঙ্গীকারবদ্ধ মনোভাব। Responsibilities & Context “মার্কেট ফ্যাসিলিটেটর” প্রতিনিধি - কৃষক, আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান এবং কৃষি ব্যবসায়িক অংশীদারদের মধ্যে মূল সংযোগ হিসেবে কাজ করবেন। এই পদের মূল দায়িত্ব হলো মাঠ পর্যায়ে কৃষকদের সাথে নিয়মিত যোগাযোগ রেখে ঋণ বিতরণ ঋণ ও আদায় ( Loan Recovery ), কৃষকের কার্যক্রম মনিটরিং এবং ঋণ সংক্রান্ত তথ্য আপডেট নিশ্চিত করা। ১. কৃষক অন্তর্ভুক্তি ও চাহিদা তৈরি নতুন কৃষকদের ডিজিটাল সিস্টেমে নিবন্ধন ও যাচাই করা। কৃষকদের তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও যাচাই করে নির্ভুলতা ও সম্পূর্ণতা নিশ্চিত করা। পণ্য ও সেবা প্রচারের জন্য সচেতনতামূলক প্রচারণা পরিচালনা করা। কৃষকদের চাহিদা বিশ্লেষণ ও সম্ভাব্য লিডকে সক্রিয় অংশগ্রহণকারীতে রূপান্তর করা। ২. ঋণ আবেদন ও বিতরণ সহায়তা অর্থায়নের যোগ্য কৃষকদের তালিকা প্রস্তুত ও যাচাই করা। কৃষকদের কাছ থেকে প্রয়োজনীয় ঋণ সংক্রান্ত নথি সংগ্রহ ও যাচাই করা। ব্যাংকিং অংশীদারদের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে অ্যাকাউন্ট খোলা ও বিতরণ কার্যক্রম সম্পন্ন করা। সময়মতো পরিষেবা ফি সংগ্রহ ও ERP সিস্টেমে সঠিক তথ্য আপডেট নিশ্চিত করা। ৩. প্রকল্প বাস্তবায়ন সহায়তা ইনপুট সংগ্রহ ও প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের সময়মতো প্রাপ্যতা নিশ্চিত করা। সিস্টেমে প্রকল্প সেটআপ ও নিবন্ধনে সহায়তা করা। মাঠ পর্যায়ের অগ্রগতি পর্যবেক্ষণ ও পরিচালনাগত সমস্যা সমাধান করা। প্রকল্প সমাপ্তি ও প্রকল্প-পরবর্তী মূল্যায়ন প্রক্রিয়ায় অংশগ্রহণ করা। ৪. পরিশোধ ও ঋণ পুনরুদ্ধার কার্যক্রম কৃষক ও ক্লায়েন্টদের কাছ থেকে দৈনিক অর্থ সংগ্রহে সহায়তা করা। নির্ধারিত সময়ে ৯৮% এবং পরবর্তী ১০ দিনের মধ্যে বাকি ২% সংগ্রহ নিশ্চিত করা। Sofol অ্যাপে সঠিক আর্থিক তথ্য সমন্বয় ও রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা। পুনরুদ্ধার পারফরম্যান্স সম্পর্কিত সময়মতো আঞ্চলিক সমন্বয়কারীর কাছে প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা। ৫. রিপোর্ট ও ডকুমেন্টেশন দৈনিক কার্যক্রম ও পুনরুদ্ধার প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত ও জমা দেওয়া। ডেটার নির্ভুলতা ও সম্পূর্ণতা বজায় রাখা। টিম কর্তৃক নির্ধারিত রিপোর্টিং চেকলিস্ট ও সময়সীমা মেনে চলা। Skills & Expertise Agriculture Credit Control And Recovery Documentation of Loan Loan Process Loan Recovery Micro Credit Microcredit NGO

নতুন কৃষকদের ডিজিটাল সিস্টেমে নিবন্ধন ও যাচাই করা।
কৃষকদের তথ্য সংগ্রহ ও যাচাই করে নির্ভুলতা ও সম্পূর্ণতা নিশ্চিত করা।
পণ্য ও সেবা প্রচারের জন্য সচেতনতামূলক প্রচারণা পরিচালনা করা।
কৃষকদের চাহিদা বিশ্লেষণ ও সম্ভাব্য লিডকে সক্রিয় অংশগ্রহণকারীতে রূপান্তর করা।
২. ঋণ আবেদন ও বিতরণ সহায়তা
অর্থায়নের যোগ্য কৃষকদের তালিকা প্রস্তুত ও যাচাই করা।
কৃষকদের কাছ থেকে প্রয়োজনীয় ঋণ সংক্রান্ত নথি সংগ্রহ ও যাচাই করা।
ব্যাংকিং অংশীদারদের সঙ্গে সমন্বয় করে অ্যাকাউন্ট খোলা ও বিতরণ কার্যক্রম সম্পন্ন করা।
সময়মতো পরিষেবা ফি সংগ্রহ ও ERP সিস্টেমে সঠিক তথ্য আপডেট নিশ্চিত করা।
৩. প্রকল্প বাস্তবায়ন সহায়তা
ইনপুট সংগ্রহ ও প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের সময়মতো প্রাপ্যতা নিশ্চিত করা।
সিস্টেমে প্রকল্প সেটআপ ও নিবন্ধনে সহায়তা করা।
মাঠ পর্যায়ের অগ্রগতি পর্যবেক্ষণ ও পরিচালনাগত সমস্যা সমাধান করা।
প্রকল্প সমাপ্তি ও প্রকল্প-পরবর্তী মূল্যায়ন প্রক্রিয়ায় অংশগ্রহণ করা।
৪. পরিশোধ ও ঋণ পুনরুদ্ধার কার্যক্রম
কৃষক ও ক্লায়েন্টদের কাছ থেকে দৈনিক অর্থ সংগ্রহে সহায়তা করা।
নির্ধারিত সময়ে ৯৮% এবং পরবর্তী ১০ দিনের মধ্যে বাকি ২% সংগ্রহ নিশ্চিত করা।
Sofol অ্যাপে সঠিক আর্থিক তথ্য সমন্বয় ও রেকর্ড সংরক্ষণ করা।
পুনরুদ্ধার পারফরম্যান্স সম্পর্কিত সময়মতো আঞ্চলিক সমন্বয়কারীর কাছে প্রতিবেদন প্রদান করা।
৫. রিপোর্ট ও ডকুমেন্টেশন
দৈনিক কার্যক্রম ও পুনরুদ্ধার প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত ও জমা দেওয়া।
ডেটার নির্ভুলতা ও সম্পূর্ণতা বজায় রাখা।
টিম কর্তৃক নির্ধারিত রিপোর্টিং চেকলিস্ট ও সময়সীমা মেনে চলা।

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor's/Master's Degree in HRM, Business Administration, Management or any relevant discipline from a reputed University.
raw_source_fields.deadline: s. Proactive, honest, hardworking and a good team player. Responsibilities & Context STEP ONE GROUP www.steponegroup.com Job Context: Step One Group is looking for a dynamic, energetic and self-motivated candidate for the position of "Executive, HRD" to support the day-to-day human resources operations of the organization. Job Responsibilities: Assist in and support day-to-day HR operations including recruitment, on-boarding and off-boarding of employees. Assist in maintaining and updating job descriptions, organograms and HR databases/records. Support the recruitment & selection process, including sourcing, screening, scheduling and conducting initial interviews. Assist in organizing orientation and training programs for new and existing employees. Maintain attendance, leave records and support payroll processing in coordination with the concerned department. Assist in ensuring compliance with company policies and applicable Bangladesh Labor Law. Support performance appraisal processes and maintain related documentation. Handle employee queries and grievances, and escalate as needed. Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information at all times. Prepare HR-related reports, letters, notices and correspondence as required. Assist in maintaining records of company assets related to employees. Perform any other tasks assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Human Resources Human Resource Management Recruitment & Selection
raw_source_fields.age: 24 to 30 years

We are building a trusted collection of original baby essentials, diapers, feeding products, skincare, toys, clothing, baby gear and mother-care products sourced from Bangladesh and international markets. We are looking for an experienced, responsible and hands-on professional who can independently manage our complete sourcing and import process—from supplier identification to customs clearance and final warehouse delivery. Key Responsibilities Research and identify reliable manufacturers, authorized distributors and export suppliers from China, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE, Europe and other relevant markets. Source diapers, wipes, feeding products, baby skincare, toys, clothing, baby gear, mother-care products and other baby essentials. Coordinate customs assessment, duty and tax calculation, port procedures and final delivery with the appointed C&F agent. Work with the sales and inventory teams to plan purchase quantities, reorder levels and stock availability. Submit weekly sourcing, order, shipment and clearance reports directly to management. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, especially comparative analysis and landed-cost calculation. Excellent professional English communication and email-writing skills. Ability to manage multiple suppliers and shipments with close attention to deadlines and documentation. Strong negotiation, analytical, problem-solving and reporting skills. Honest, accountable, detail-oriented and able to take ownership of the complete import cycle. Preferred Experience Experience importing FMCG, baby products, cosmetics, food, toys, garments or consumer goods. Existing connections with international suppliers, freight forwarders or reliable C&F agents. Experience working with suppliers in China, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE or Europe. Knowledge of Bangladesh Customs, IRC, LC/TT procedures and relevant regulatory authorities will be highly valued.
