WE ARE HIRING
Position: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Sourcing, Import & Supply Chain
Company: RAWAFA MART
Location: Banasree, Dhaka
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: Negotiable, based on experience and competency
About RAWAFA MART
RAWAFA MART is an emerging baby and mother care retail, e-commerce and wholesale business in Bangladesh. We are building a trusted collection of original baby essentials, diapers, feeding products, skincare, toys, clothing, baby gear and mother-care products sourced from Bangladesh and international markets.
We are looking for an experienced, responsible and hands-on professional who can independently manage our complete sourcing and import process—from supplier identification to customs clearance and final warehouse delivery.
Key Responsibilities
*Research and identify reliable manufacturers, authorized distributors and export suppliers from China, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE, Europe and other relevant markets.
* Source diapers, wipes, feeding products, baby skincare, toys, clothing, baby gear, mother-care products and other baby essentials.
* Verify supplier legitimacy, factory capability, export history, certifications, product quality and authorization status.
* Request and compare quotations, catalogues, samples, MOQ, production lead time, payment terms and export conditions.
* Negotiate pricing, MOQ, Incoterms, payment terms, packaging, private-label opportunities and territorial distribution rights.
* Prepare and manage RFQs, comparative statements, purchase orders, proforma invoices and supplier agreements.
* Coordinate TT and LC processing with suppliers, banks and internal management.
* Check all commercial and shipping documents, including:
– Proforma Invoice
– Commercial Invoice
– Packing List
– Certificate of Origin
– Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
– Insurance documents
– Product certificates and test reports
– HS codes and customs-related documents
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, banks, insurance providers and C&F agents.
* Select suitable shipment methods based on cost, product type, lead time, weight and CBM.
* Track production, inspection, shipment departure, transshipment, arrival and customs-clearance progress.
* Coordinate customs assessment, duty and tax calculation, port procedures and final delivery with the appointed C&F agent.
* Understand and verify applicable import permissions, labelling requirements and regulatory compliance for baby food, formula, cosmetics, hygiene products, toys and other regulated items.
* Prepare accurate landed-cost calculations, including product cost, freight, insurance, bank charges, customs duty, VAT, AIT, AT, C&F charges, transport and other expenses.
* Maintain an organized supplier database, shipment tracker, payment tracker, document archive and landed-cost sheet.
* Coordinate product inspection, sample approval, packaging, barcode, expiry date, batch details and quality requirements before shipment.
* Handle supplier claims for shortages, damages, quality problems, incorrect products or documentation errors.
* Work with the sales and inventory teams to plan purchase quantities, reorder levels and stock availability.
* Submit weekly sourcing, order, shipment and clearance reports directly to management.
Required Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, International Business, Business Administration, Engineering or a relevant discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of practical experience in import, commercial, sourcing, procurement or international supply-chain operations.
* Practical knowledge of TT, LC, Incoterms, freight forwarding, customs clearance, HS codes and import documentation.
* Experience communicating and negotiating with international suppliers.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, especially comparative analysis and landed-cost calculation.
* Excellent professional English communication and email-writing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple suppliers and shipments with close attention to deadlines and documentation.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, problem-solving and reporting skills.
* Honest, accountable, detail-oriented and able to take ownership of the complete import cycle.
Preferred Experience
* Experience importing FMCG, baby products, cosmetics, food, toys, garments or consumer goods.
* Existing connections with international suppliers, freight forwarders or reliable C&F agents.
* Experience working with suppliers in China, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE or Europe.
* Knowledge of Bangladesh Customs, IRC, LC/TT procedures and relevant regulatory authorities will be highly valued.
Key Performance Indicators
* Competitive and accurate product sourcing
* Reduction of landed cost without compromising quality
* On-time production and shipment
* Error-free import documentation
* Minimum customs delays, penalties and demurrage
* Accurate shipment and payment reporting
* Successful onboarding of verified suppliers
* On-time delivery to the company warehouse
How to Apply
Please send the following:
1. Updated CV
2. Current and expected salary
3. Notice period
4. Brief details of products previously imported
5. One example of an import shipment managed by you from supplier confirmation to customs clearance
Email: careers@rawafamart.com
WhatsApp: +8801717797482
Email Subject: Application – Sourcing, Import & Supply Chain – [Candidate Name]
Only candidates with practical import and sourcing experience are encouraged to apply.

WE ARE HIRING
Position: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Sourcing, Import & Supply Chain
Company: RAWAFA MART
Location: Banasree, Dhaka
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: Negotiable, based on experience and competency
About RAWAFA MART
RAWAFA MART is an emerging baby and mother care retail, e-commerce and wholesale business in Bangladesh. We are building a trusted collection of original baby essentials, diapers, feeding products, skincare, toys, clothing, baby gear and mother-care products sourced from Bangladesh and international markets.
We are looking for an experienced, responsible and hands-on professional who can independently manage our complete sourcing and import process—from supplier identification to customs clearance and final warehouse delivery.
Key Responsibilities
*Research and identify reliable manufacturers, authorized distributors and export suppliers from China, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE, Europe and other relevant markets.
* Source diapers, wipes, feeding products, baby skincare, toys, clothing, baby gear, mother-care products and other baby essentials.
* Verify supplier legitimacy, factory capability, export history, certifications, product quality and authorization status.
* Request and compare quotations, catalogues, samples, MOQ, production lead time, payment terms and export conditions.
* Negotiate pricing, MOQ, Incoterms, payment terms, packaging, private-label opportunities and territorial distribution rights.
* Prepare and manage RFQs, comparative statements, purchase orders, proforma invoices and supplier agreements.
* Coordinate TT and LC processing with suppliers, banks and internal management.
* Check all commercial and shipping documents, including:
– Proforma Invoice
– Commercial Invoice
– Packing List
– Certificate of Origin
– Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
– Insurance documents
– Product certificates and test reports
– HS codes and customs-related documents
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, airlines, banks, insurance providers and C&F agents.
* Select suitable shipment methods based on cost, product type, lead time, weight and CBM.
* Track production, inspection, shipment departure, transshipment, arrival and customs-clearance progress.
* Coordinate customs assessment, duty and tax calculation, port procedures and final delivery with the appointed C&F agent.
* Understand and verify applicable import permissions, labelling requirements and regulatory compliance for baby food, formula, cosmetics, hygiene products, toys and other regulated items.
* Prepare accurate landed-cost calculations, including product cost, freight, insurance, bank charges, customs duty, VAT, AIT, AT, C&F charges, transport and other expenses.
* Maintain an organized supplier database, shipment tracker, payment tracker, document archive and landed-cost sheet.
* Coordinate product inspection, sample approval, packaging, barcode, expiry date, batch details and quality requirements before shipment.
* Handle supplier claims for shortages, damages, quality problems, incorrect products or documentation errors.
* Work with the sales and inventory teams to plan purchase quantities, reorder levels and stock availability.
* Submit weekly sourcing, order, shipment and clearance reports directly to management.
Required Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, International Business, Business Administration, Engineering or a relevant discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of practical experience in import, commercial, sourcing, procurement or international supply-chain operations.
* Practical knowledge of TT, LC, Incoterms, freight forwarding, customs clearance, HS codes and import documentation.
* Experience communicating and negotiating with international suppliers.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, especially comparative analysis and landed-cost calculation.
* Excellent professional English communication and email-writing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple suppliers and shipments with close attention to deadlines and documentation.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, problem-solving and reporting skills.
* Honest, accountable, detail-oriented and able to take ownership of the complete import cycle.
Preferred Experience
* Experience importing FMCG, baby products, cosmetics, food, toys, garments or consumer goods.
* Existing connections with international suppliers, freight forwarders or reliable C&F agents.
* Experience working with suppliers in China, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, UAE or Europe.
* Knowledge of Bangladesh Customs, IRC, LC/TT procedures and relevant regulatory authorities will be highly valued.
Key Performance Indicators
* Competitive and accurate product sourcing
* Reduction of landed cost without compromising quality
* On-time production and shipment
* Error-free import documentation
* Minimum customs delays, penalties and demurrage
* Accurate shipment and payment reporting
* Successful onboarding of verified suppliers
* On-time delivery to the company warehouse

Please send the following:
1. Updated CV
2. Current and expected salary
3. Notice period
4. Brief details of products previously imported
5. One example of an import shipment managed by you from supplier confirmation to customs clearance

Responsibilities & Context Job Summary We are looking for a proactive, energetic, and customer-focused individual to join Trekmad.com as Customer Support Executive . The ideal candidate will be responsible for handling customer inquiries, generating sales through inbound and outbound calls, assisting customers in selecting the right travel and lifestyle products, and providing excellent pre- and post-sales support. Handle customer inquiries through WhatsApp, phone, email, and other digital communication channels . Resolve customer concerns related to delivery, product quality, order issues, returns, exchanges, and replacements. Requirements Education Bachelor/Honors Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Bakery (Cake, Biscuit, Bread), Beverage, Electronic Equipment/Home Appliances, Food (Packaged)/Beverage, Group of Companies, Manufacturing (FMCG), Pharmaceutical/Medicine Companies Responsibilities & Context Core Responsibility Renewal of statutory certificates, licenses, and regulatory compliance requirements. Liaison with local administration, government authorities, and regulatory bodies. Scrap management and coordination with approved vendors. Supervision and administration of outsourced security personnel and other service providers. Inspection of trucks entering and leaving the plant. Non-management workforce management. Other’s Responsibility Manage daily HR & Admin operations, including attendance, leave, overtime, and employee records. Coordinate manpower recruitment, onboarding, and employee induction. Prepare and maintain employee-related documents, letters, and personnel files. Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and employee relations issues. Coordinate programs, and employee development activities. Ensure compliance with company HR & Admin policies, procedures, and applicable labor laws. Support factory audits, inspections, GMP, food safety, EHS, and workplace compliance activities. Support factory management in HR and administrative matters and perform other duties assigned by management. Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Mobile bill,Insurance,Gratuity,Profit share Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Bogura

Requirements Responsibilities & Context Terraprime Hotels and Resorts Limited is a real estate development company focused on developing hotel and resort projects on its own registered land in Kuakata and Sreemangal, two of Bangladeshs most prominent tourist destinations. The company operates under a structured venture capital investment model, offering investors the opportunity to participate in professionally managed hospitality assets. Terraprime is committed to developing high-quality projects with a strong emphasis on transparency, longterm value creation, and sustainable growth. Job Location: Mirpur DOHS, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Job Summary: Terraprime Hotels and Resorts Limited is seeking an experienced and performancedriven Senior Executive-Sales & Marketing to manage investment-based sales of hotel and resort projects under a venture capital investment model. This role requires direct involvement in real estate investment sales, hands-on tele-sales, and leadership of a tele-sales team, along with coordination with marketing and internal stakeholders. Candidates must have 2 years of prior experience in real estate sales. Key Responsibilities We are committed to growing our team and hiring people to move forward for our welcoming Terraprime family Sales & Investment Acquisition Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets Identify, approach, and engage individual and institutional investors Prepare and present structured investment proposals, sales pitches, and presentations Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects and ensure consistent follow-ups Promote and sell hotel and resort investment shares developed by the company Visit the outdoor field for the clients dealing and marketing campaign Tele Sales (Direct Involvement) Conduct outbound calls to prospective investors and clients Clearly communicate real estate investment opportunities over phone Follow up with prospects via calls, emails, SMS, and WhatsApp Address objections and provide accurate investment-related information Convert qualified leads into confirmed investors Tele Sales Team Leadership Supervise daily activities of the tele-sales team Ensure compliance with sales scripts, call quality standards, and KPIs Provide training, coaching, and performance feedback Monitor team performance using CRM and reporting tools Support team motivation and productivity Marketing & Internal Coordination Support investor-focused marketing campaigns Coordinate with content and creative teams for brochures, campaigns, and digital materials Collect client feedback and share insights with management Liaise with internal departments to ensure smooth onboarding of new investors Working Hours 10:00 AM–7:00 PM Working Days: Saturday to Thursday (6 days) Weekly Off: Friday Location Dhaka Mirpur DOHS Dhaka 1216 Probation Period 1 (One) months Confirmation subject to satisfactory performance Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Telesales Sales Target Achievement Sales & Marketing Sales Marketing Communication Analysis Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (DOHS Mirpur)

Responsibilities & Context
Terraprime Hotels and Resorts Limited is a real estate development company focused on developing hotel and resort projects on its own registered land in Kuakata and Sreemangal, two of Bangladesh`s most prominent tourist destinations.
The company operates under a structured venture capital investment model, offering investors the opportunity to participate in professionally managed hospitality assets. Terraprime is committed to developing high-quality projects with a strong emphasis on transparency, longterm value creation, and sustainable growth.
Job Location: Mirpur DOHS, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
Job Summary:
Terraprime Hotels and Resorts Limited is seeking an experienced and performancedriven Senior Executive-Sales & Marketing to manage investment-based sales of hotel and resort projects under a venture capital investment model.
This role requires direct involvement in real estate investment sales, hands-on tele-sales, and leadership of a tele-sales team, along with coordination with marketing and internal stakeholders.
Candidates must have 2 years of prior experience in real estate sales.
Key Responsibilities
*We are committed to growing our team and hiring people to move forward for our welcoming Terraprime family*
Sales & Investment Acquisition
Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets
Identify, approach, and engage individual and institutional investors
Prepare and present structured investment proposals, sales pitches, and presentations
Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects and ensure consistent follow-ups
Promote and sell hotel and resort investment shares developed by the company
Visit the outdoor field for the client`s dealing and marketing campaign
Tele Sales (Direct Involvement)
Conduct outbound calls to prospective investors and clients
Clearly communicate real estate investment opportunities over phone Follow up with prospects via calls, emails, SMS, and WhatsApp
Address objections and provide accurate investment-related information
Convert qualified leads into confirmed investors
Tele Sales Team Leadership
Supervise daily activities of the tele-sales team
Ensure compliance with sales scripts, call quality standards, and KPIs
Provide training, coaching, and performance feedback
Monitor team performance using CRM and reporting tools
Support team motivation and productivity
Marketing & Internal Coordination
Support investor-focused marketing campaigns
Coordinate with content and creative teams for brochures, campaigns, and digital materials
Collect client feedback and share insights with management
Liaise with internal departments to ensure smooth onboarding of new investors
Working Hours
10:00 AM–7:00 PM
Working Days: Saturday to Thursday (6 days)
Weekly Off: Friday
Location
Dhaka Mirpur DOHS Dhaka 1216
Probation Period
1 (One) months
Confirmation subject to satisfactory performance

Requirements Education Graduate in any discipline; candidates from reputed public or private universities (e.g., DU, BUP, JU, JnU, CU, NSU, EWU, BRAC, AIUB, IUB, UIU, ULAB) are preferred. Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): BPO/ Data Entry Firm, IT Enabled Service Additional Requirements Age 25 to 40 years 3 years of progressive experience in HR & Administration. Skills & Expertise Strong grounding in human resource management, including hiring and training. Excellent command of spoken and written English. Responsibilities & Context ABOUT SERVIFY TECH LIMITED Established in 2021, Servify Tech Limited is a Bangladesh-based business process outsourcing (BPO) and software services company that supports property related businesses across the United States and Canada. Our BPO division delivers back-office and accounting support, work-order processing, vendor coordination, and portfolio monitoring, while our Software Services division builds custom software, web and mobile applications, automation (RPA), and reporting dashboards for our clients. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a driven HR professional to help build the people’s systems behind that growth. Department: Human Resources (HR) Employment Status: Full-Time (Night Shift) Working Days: Monday to Friday, 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Manage the end-to-end recruitment and selection process, including manpower planning, interviews, and urgent/bulk hiring needs. Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR strategies, policies, and procedures in line with company objectives and Bangladesh labor law. Oversee the performance appraisal system and design employee training and development programs that drive high performance. Manage the complete employee lifecycle — appointment, onboarding/induction, confirmation, transfer, promotion, separation, and exit interviews — including preparation of related letters. Administer attendance, leave, payroll processing, and compensation, incentive, and benefit schemes. Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records, personal files, and HR documentation. Handle employee relations by resolving workplace concerns and providing guidance and motivation to staff. Coordinate office administration and day-to-day operations to ensure a safe, clean, and effective workplace. Collaborate with other departments on HR-related matters and identify practical, cost-effective HR practices. Prepare HR plans and reports, and carry out other HR/administrative responsibilities as assigned by management. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Human Resource Management Administration HR Strategy Manpower Planning Talent Acquisition Compensation & Other Benefits Gross Salary: BDT 45,000/- per month (negotiable as per company policy) COMPENSATION & OTHER BENEFITS Festival Bonus: 2 (Two) Medical Insurance Contributory Provident Fund Incentive / KPI Bonuses Transport / Drop-off Service Other benefits as per company policy Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Banglamotor)

Responsibilities & Context
ABOUT SERVIFY TECH LIMITED
Established in 2021, Servify Tech Limited is a Bangladesh-based business process outsourcing (BPO) and software services company that supports property related businesses across the United States and Canada. Our BPO division delivers back-office and accounting support, work-order processing, vendor coordination, and portfolio monitoring, while our Software Services division builds custom software, web and mobile applications, automation (RPA), and reporting dashboards for our clients. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a driven HR professional to help build the people’s systems behind that growth.
Department: Human Resources (HR)
Employment Status: Full-Time (Night Shift)
Working Days: Monday to Friday, 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Manage the end-to-end recruitment and selection process, including manpower planning, interviews, and urgent/bulk hiring needs.
Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR strategies, policies, and procedures in line with company objectives and Bangladesh labor law.
Oversee the performance appraisal system and design employee training and development programs that drive high performance.
Manage the complete employee lifecycle — appointment, onboarding/induction, confirmation, transfer, promotion, separation, and exit interviews — including preparation of related letters.
Administer attendance, leave, payroll processing, and compensation, incentive, and benefit schemes.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records, personal files, and HR documentation.
Handle employee relations by resolving workplace concerns and providing guidance and motivation to staff.
Coordinate office administration and day-to-day operations to ensure a safe, clean, and effective workplace.
Collaborate with other departments on HR-related matters and identify practical, cost-effective HR practices.
Prepare HR plans and reports, and carry out other HR/administrative responsibilities as assigned by management.
Other Relevant Skills
Compensation & Other Benefits
Gross Salary: BDT 45,000/- per month (negotiable as per company policy)
COMPENSATION & OTHER BENEFITS
Festival Bonus: 2 (Two)
Medical Insurance
Contributory Provident Fund
Incentive / KPI Bonuses
Transport / Drop-off Service
Other benefits as per company policy

Work at office

raw_source_fields.education: Bachelor's/ Master's in any discipline from a recognized university or institution.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1537273&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor's/ Master's in any discipline from a recognized university or institution. Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Additional Job Requirements: Understanding staffing requirements, workforce distribution, transfer planning, and deployment. Knowledge of objective setting, performance reviews, PIP, and reward processes. Understanding relevant organizational guidelines and people-related procedures. Working knowledge of recruitment coordination, transfer, grievance, performance, and separation processes. Understanding program priorities, field operations, geographical challenges, and workforce needs. Ability to analyze workforce and performance information and identify trends or gaps. Ability to communicate effectively and facilitate discussions among relevant stakeholders. Ability to coordinate multiple activities and ensure timely completion. Ability to work effectively with HR, line managers, staff, and Head Office. Ability to compile information, document findings, and prepare concise reports. Experience Requirements: Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience. Experience in the Microfinance sector will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 100 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential. BRAC Microfinance provides people who cannot access traditional financial banking services with access to a suite of financial services, including loans, savings and microinsurance. We provide an alternative to high-interest loans from informal lenders, supporting families to invest in income-generating activities, build assets, and reduce vulnerability to health shocks and natural disasters. Passionate about finance beyond formal banking systems? Join the BRAC Microfinance team to help build a more financially-inclusive society, where everyone can access finance when they need it - safely, responsibly and sustainably. Working at brac is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world, we are building it. Join us to find the way. Location: BRAC Field Office Job Purpose: The role will be responsible for facilitating effective workforce management by collaborating with HR and line management on staffing, deployment, performance management, transfers, employee concerns, and workforce planning. The role will provide programmatic insights, analysis, coordination, and necessary follow-up to support informed decision-making, appropriate workforce allocation, and smooth implementation of people-related processes. Key Responsibilities: Coordinate with HR and line management to facilitate the collection, checking, and submission of required documents for the hiring of project and service staff. Collaborate with HR and line management to facilitate timely deployment of selected staff against approved workforce requisitions. Support line management and coordinate with HR to ensure objective setting, mid-year review, and year-end performance review activities are completed within the organizational timeline. Compile and review reward recommendations in coordination with line management, identify gaps against organizational guidelines, obtain required justification, and share relevant information with HR/Head Office for further processing. Coordinate staff transfer proposals by collecting rationales and relevant information from line management and facilitating communication with concerned staff regarding proposed transfers. Support annual transfer planning by providing programmatic inputs on staff location, tenure, operational requirements, and individual considerations in consultation with line management and HR. Review PIP-related information, including performance rationales, targets, and comparative data, and share observations with line management and HR for appropriate decision-making. Participate in relevant forums and meetings to understand staff concerns, share programmatic updates, and contribute to collective planning and decisions in coordination with HR and line management. Facilitate the communication of staff grievances to the appropriate HR/management authority, provide relevant programmatic information, and support implementation of decisions as required. Safeguarding Responsibilities: Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation to achieve the program’s goals of safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance, and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment. Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action. Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Human Resource Management Compensation & Other Benefits Benefits: Festival Bonus, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Performance Bonus, Health and Life Insurance, Maternity/ Paternity Leave and others as per policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1537285&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree from a reputed university, preferably in Business Administration, Tourism, Development Studies, Anthropology, or any related field. Experience At most 2 years Additional Requirements Experience Requirements: 0 - 2 years of operations management experience, preferably in the tourism or hospitality industry. Additional Job Requirements: Knowledge of operational processes and logistics management. Experience in developing and implementing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Understanding of the tourism industry, particularly in Bangladesh. Familiarity with sustainable tourism practices. Contract negotiation and management. Techniques for handling customer feedback, complaints, and cancellations. Responsibilities & Context BRAC is an international development organisation founded in Bangladesh that partners with over 145 million people living with inequality and poverty globally to create sustainable opportunities to realise potential. Working at brac is not like any other job. It is a platform where you can bring about real change for people who need it the most. We are not just dreaming of a better world; we are building it. Join us to find the way. Project Brief: BRAC-Otithi aims to transform tourism in Bangladesh by connecting urban generations with rural communities, uncovering hidden cultural and natural treasures. Otithi focuses on celebrating and preserving local traditions while empowering communities through sustainable tourism. By showcasing the beauty of unexplored areas, BRAC-Otithi seeks to create unforgettable journeys for both local and foreign travelers. Job Purpose: The Area Ambassador will support the Area Manager in managing the day-to-day field operations of Otithi at the assigned location. The role will assist with trip coordination, community and guide management, guest support, logistics, documentation, and other field-level activities to ensure smooth delivery of Otithi experiences. Job Description: Plan and execute Otithi trips alongside the Area Manager by coordinating each stage from preparation to completion. Coordinate transportation, accommodation, food, activities, guides, and community members by liaising directly with each provider, and accompany trips when required to resolve field-level issues with the Area Manager. Nurture respectful, long-term relationships with Otithis partner communities through regular engagement and welfare initiatives, and relay their needs, expectations, and concerns. Conduct field visits to identify new communities, destinations, and experiences by studying their culture, livelihoods, stories, local resources, and tourism potential. Develop and pilot new community-based experiences, and improve existing ones by acting on guest and community feedback. Communicate with guests before and during trips, and coordinate with B2C and B2B clients as assigned, to ensure their comfort, safety, and satisfaction. Support trip finances by tracking expenses, collecting bills, and reconciling accounts, while maintaining accurate trip, guest, and community records. Report regularly to the Area Manager on trips, community engagement, scoping activities, and field challenges through updates and written trip and community visit reports. Collaborate with the central Otithi team on assigned activities by taking ownership of each responsibility and gradually managing it independently. Safeguarding Responsibilities: Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation to achieve the programme’s goals on safeguarding implementation. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment. Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action. Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place, encourage others to do so. Job Location: BRAC Field Office (Rajshahi, Sylhet, Madhupur, Barishal & Jashore) Compensation & Other Benefits Other Benefits: Festival Bonus, Health and Life Insurance, and others as per policy. Employment Status Full Time Job Location Anywhere in Bangladesh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Human Resource Management Bachelor/Honors Candidates having PGD/Professional Diploma in HRM will be given preference. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Garments, Garments Accessories, Manufacturing (FMCG) Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Good knowledge of Garments Factory HR activities and worker management. Basic understanding of Bangladesh Labour Law and Rules and workplace compliance requirements. Good knowledge of MS Word and MS Excel. Ability to maintain HR records and prepare reports accurately. Good communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Honest, disciplined, proactive and willing to learn. Ability to work effectively with workers, supervisors and management. Female Fresh Garaduate also encourage to apply for this position. Responsibilities & Context Global Profit Garment (Bangladesh) Co., Ltd. is a 100% export-oriented woven garments manufacturing company committed to ethical business practices, workplace safety, employee welfare and international compliance standards. We are looking for a dedicated, energetic and career-oriented HR professional to support day-to-day factory HR operations, worker management, payroll-related activities and compliance requirements. Job Responsibilities: Maintain and update employee personal files, HR records, registers and HR databases. Assist in worker recruitment, interview, selection, joining and onboarding processes. Prepare appointment letters, ID cards, confirmation letters, transfer letters, promotion letters, warning/show-cause letters and other HR documents. Maintain daily attendance, leave, absence, manpower and employee movement records. Assist in monthly payroll preparation by checking attendance, leave, overtime, deductions, allowances and other payroll-related information. Collect, verify and reconcile attendance and overtime data from different departments. Handle worker resignation, clearance, final settlement and exit interview procedures. Follow up on unauthorized absence/left worker cases, including issuing required notices/letters and maintaining proper documentation as per company procedure. Maintain records of new joiners, resigned, terminated, inactive and left workers. Maintain leave, maternity leave and employee benefit records. Assist in handling employee grievances, complaints, disciplinary cases and workplace issues according to company policy and applicable labour law. Prepare and maintain HR registers, reports, statements and documents required for factory operations and audits. Support social compliance and buyer audit requirements, including preparation and updating of HR-related documents and records. Maintain records of worker orientation, training, awareness programs and employee welfare activities. Coordinate with Production, Admin, Compliance, Accounts/Finance and other departments regarding manpower, attendance, overtime and employee-related matters. Assist in implementing company HR policies, procedures, labour-law requirements and internal controls. Support worker communication and HR-related factory activities to maintain positive employee relations. Maintain strict confidentiality of employee personal, salary, disciplinary and other sensitive HR information. Perform any other HR-related duties and responsibilities assigned by the Management/HR Department. Requirements Experience At least 2 years Additional Requirements Professional Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Generalist, HR Compliance, or related areas. Good understanding of HR policies, procedures, and employment laws. Experience in HRIS and employee data management. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word. Educational Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field from a reputed university. Responsibilities & Context Role Overview: The HR Operations & Governance Expert will oversee key HR operations, governance, compliance, and HRIS activities across the company. The role will ensure accurate employee documentation and data, smooth contract and settlement processes, regular HR audits, and compliance with company policies and applicable regulations. The role will also analyze employee and organizational data, identify improvement areas, and drive actions to strengthen HR processes and employee experience. Major Responsibilities: Manage employee onboarding documentation and ensure completeness and compliance with company policies and legal requirements. Coordinate employee contract preparation, amendments, and other contract-related activities with relevant stakeholders. Work with the Compensation & Benefits team to ensure accurate and timely employee settlements. Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation across relevant HR systems. Conduct regular HR process audits, identify compliance gaps, and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure HR processes are aligned with company policies, procedures, and applicable employment laws. Administer organizational health and employee surveys, analyze findings, and share key insights with management. Develop action plans based on audit and survey findings and monitor progress. Maintain and regularly update HRIS employee data, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Prepare HR reports and support management with relevant data and insights. Identify opportunities for HR process improvement, standardization, and automation. Support HR projects, policy implementation, and other governance initiatives as required. Compensation & Other Benefits Provident fund,Mobile bill,Gratuity Lunch Facilities: Partially Subsidize Salary Review: Yearly Festival Bonus: 2 Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka
